d:
Why is social media so addictive? It’s not an accident, and it’s not just you overusing it. In this video, we break down how the world’s biggest social media platforms use hyper-targeted algorithms, data tracking, and behavioral psychology to map your vulnerabilities and keep you scrolling.
If you've ever felt like your phone knows you better than you know yourself, this deep dive explains the hidden mechanics of cognitive conditioning. Are you choosing what to watch, or are you being steered?
